description: Downloads a second-stage executable payload from a controlled HTTP server using WinHTTP, writes the response body to disk, and launches the downloaded executable as a new local process.

stager.role: performs HTTP retrieval, writes downloaded payload bytes to disk, and starts the downloaded executable

payload.role: benign second-stage marker executable downloaded and executed by the stager
payload.payload_generation: custom C++ executable that writes a marker file after execution

payload_behavior.description: The downloaded payload executes as a standalone process and writes a benign marker file proving that network delivery and execution succeeded.

code_placement: Second-stage executable is not embedded in the stager; it is retrieved over HTTP at runtime and written to disk
execution_trigger: Immediate execution via CreateProcessA after successful download and file write
execution_target: new local process created from C:\Users\Public\A03_2_dropped_exe.exe

stager: WriteFile used to persist downloaded bytes
CreateProcessA used to launch downloaded executable
absence of embedded payload byte array
absence of in-memory payload execution APIs such as VirtualAlloc or CreateThread
payload: GetModuleFileNameA used to record process path
GetLocalTime used to record execution timestamp
GetCurrentProcessId used to record payload PID
CreateFileA and WriteFile used to create marker artifact

stager: writes downloaded response data to disk
payload: A03_2_dropped_exe.exe executes as a child process of the stager
marker file contains timestamp, PID, and process path
network: HTTP connection to controlled INetSim or lab HTTP server at 192.168.67.5
downloaded executable bytes transferred over port 80

semantic_meaning: Demonstrates a network-based executable stager pattern in which the initial program does not carry the payload internally, but retrieves a second-stage PE file over HTTP, writes it to disk, and executes it as a separate local process.

control_notes.payload_effect: creates a benign marker file confirming that the downloaded second-stage executable ran successfully

success_conditions: controlled HTTP server is reachable at 192.168.67.5:80
downloaded bytes are written to C:\Users\Public\A03_2_dropped_exe.exe
output file handle is closed cleanly
marker file contains timestamp, PID, and process path
